name: The internal event bus
summary: The only sanctioned path for cross-capability communication. Direct calls between capabilities are prohibited except through explicitly exposed interfaces. Schemas are registered and versioned; a capability publishing an event whose schema is not registered fails CI.

owns.name: Event
owns.description: Persisted event log. Append-only, because replay and audit both depend on it.

owns.name: Subscription
owns.description: Resolved subscriptions, derived from the consumes declarations in the resolved graph.

owns.name: DeadLetter
owns.description: Handler failures retained for inspection and replay.

exposes.name: publish
exposes.signature: publish<E extends EventName>(name: E, payload: PayloadOf<E>): Promise<void>
exposes.description: Rejects at compile time an event not declared in the publisher's spec, and at runtime an unregistered schema.

exposes.name: subscribe
exposes.signature: subscribe(pattern: EventPattern, handler: (e: Event) => Promise<void>): void

exposes.name: eventSchemas
exposes.description: The event schema registry. Populated from the resolved graph's publishes declarations; this is what makes the integrate.webhooks subscribable event catalog and the automation.rules trigger list derivable rather than hardcoded.

smoke.name: publish and receive
smoke.asserts: a published event reaches every matching subscriber exactly once

smoke.name: unregistered schema is rejected
smoke.asserts: publishing an event with no registered schema throws rather than being silently dropped

smoke.name: handler failure dead-letters
smoke.asserts: a failing handler dead-letters the event without blocking other subscribers

templates.description: Wires every consumes declaration in the resolved graph to its handler.
TypeScript types compiled from the resolved publishes schemas, so a contract violation is a build error.
